title: Excellent guide for Albaicin and Sacromonte Granada
text: We had the great pleasure of taking a walking tour with Mario, a guide we met at the Plaza Nueva tour office.  Although we were staying in Albaicin, Mario took us to many places we would have never seen or known about.  He was very knowledgable regarding the history of the area, personable, and paced the tour well as much of it was uphill.  He made it easy and enjoyable for us.  The tour of Sacromante was particularly interesting.  We highly recommend you ask for him if you have the pleasure of spending time in Granada.
author: ellenc826

title: Take this tour, and ask for Marta!
text: I think this is a must do if you have the opportunity to visit Granada. Our guide, Marta, was exceptional. She was funny, engaging and VERY well informed. She made this trip well worth our time, and left us with some great recommendations for dinner!
author: 255brandieb

title: Albaizin and Sacromonte walking tour with Mario!
text: We did this tour with Sixthrills with Mario as our guide. He was a wealth of historical information, good English, and very open to all our questions. The albaicin is a maze of cobbled streets that he navigated with lots of commentary and explanations. The added bonus was that we did NOT get lost! Mario brought us to a number of beautiful view points. We continued to climb to see the caves in Sacromonte. Be aware there are lots of stairs and incline. We were lucky to be the only couple of this tour so Mario was able to accommodate to our tempo and ability. Thank you for a great tour!

title: educational and fun
text:

title: A wonderful walk with Jose "Valdy"
text:
A wonderful experience from Jose, a great professional who makes the slopes of the Albaicin count less climbing
Dozens of anecdotes, adapt to the needs of the group
Discovering wonderful viewpoints, there is not only St. Nicholas, and making the experience something impossible to forget.
